title: The Kubernetes API lists namespaces without signing in
summary: The Kubernetes API server lists its namespaces to a caller with no credentials.  Anonymous access is allowed past the public endpoints, so the cluster can be read and often changed.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: curl -sk https://host/api/v1/namespaces and look for "kind":"NamespaceList".  /version answering alone is normal and is not this finding.
remediate: Require authentication and authorization on the API server.
